title: Not absorbent at all...
text:
Not absorbent at all.... I guess if you buy these to do needle work on, they will be fine because they are thick to the point of being stiff.

I bought them to use as absorbent kitchen towels. You know to dry dishes, hands, wipe down counters, etc. and sadly they don't work for that. I've never used a towel that left my hands just as wet after using it as they were before using it!

They didn't seem to shrink much after 3 washes but they do wrinkle quite a bit and I'm not interested in ironing my dish towels.

product_metadata.title: Aunt Martha's PKMAR 3-Pack Retro Maroon Striped Dish Towels, 18 by 28-Inch
features: Machine wash in cold water; tumble dry low heat
description: Aunt Martha's premium quality retro maroon "box" striped dish towels. These towels have a maroon colored stripe pattern along all 4 sides of the towel. Each towel is 18"x28" in size. The towels have a premium 130 thread count, making them ideal for embroidery projects or simply to use as a regular kitchen towel.
